scene: The brass telescope clicks, revealing three strange transit stops below.
picture: Along a level wooden ledge, the mustachioed man in his straw hat and red poncho with guitar on back stands by the brass telescope on the left. On the far left, a glowing blue night bus waits below a ramp. Up high, a striped gondola hovers. On the far right, an iron book cart lift waits open.
shown: a glowing blue night bus waiting at the curb on the far left
a striped ferris wheel gondola hovering empty up high above the centre
a squeaky iron book cart lift open on the far right
